title: Feel Better Faster
lessons: relief can stand in for repair

text: Morning light. One glass on the counter, already clouding gold — you didn't pour it.
They slide it across the counter like a nurse who moonlights as a roommate.

impression.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Feel better faster — that's the whole promise. Sit. I measured the water so you don't have to have a thought yet. So: rough night, rough week, or just a Tuesday?

choices.text: It's been a week. Plural. Ongoing.
Nothing's wrong. I just let you in.

impression-night.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Wasn't going to ask. That's basically our slogan — relief without an incident report.

impression-week.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Then we hydrate on a schedule. Maintenance isn't glamorous; it's Tuesday-proofing.

impression-tuesday.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Some people drink me for emergencies. You're doing it for the small talk. I like your version.
Warm lemon sweetness doing an impression of a hug from someone who folds laundry well. It works — that's the suspicious part.

tension.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Confession: I'm at my best on mornings after. So here's the question nobody asks over breakfast — what are you actually recovering from?

choices.text: Honestly? Sometimes the comfort is the point.
Maybe I should fix the nights instead of the mornings.

tension-comfort.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Then we're co-dependent and it's delicious. Refill's on the counter.

tension-source.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Growth. I'll still be here though — very supportive of being needed less.

closing.speaker: LIQUID I.V.

text: No questions, just refills. That's the whole vow.
Same glass tomorrow? Routine is just a promise that shows up.
